model.name: Table of Contents
model.description:
Table of Content Widget

Widget for Figma to visualize pages as cards for index page, widget also includes statuses and descriptions for each page, very useful as a file guide for your team.


How to use:

  1. Add the widget to your Figma file.
  2. Use names without alphabetical letters to create separators between lists
  3. Use emojis at the beginning of the name of your pages to display them as an icon
  4. Click on the file description to change it.
  5. Click on status to change it to need.
  6. Enter a description for a page.


How does the icon work?

  • If the first symbols (up to 4) in the name of your file are emoji, the widget will display them separately as icons, 
  • If no emoji are used in the beginning then the widget will display the default blue icon (possible to turn it off in the property menu)


How to separate my pages?

  • If your page has no alphabetical letters (all languages are supported) then the widget will count it as a separator and will separate the cards


Property Menu:

  • Size: changing this property will configure the global scale of the widget, there are 4 sizes: extra small, small, medium, and large.
  • Theme: change the theme of the page cards, there are two options light and dark.
  • Show description: you can toggle on/off file descriptions, and descriptions for the page cards.
  • Show status: the toggle shows/hides the status in the page cards.
  • Show icon: the toggle shows icons separately or merged with the page and file name
  • Refresh: will refresh names, descriptions, and statuses, if you update it in the file or another copy of the widget in the same file.

  • Specify a column by pressing on the dropdown with the name of the current column
  • Press on the arrow next to column selection, to instantly push your ticket to the next column

Property Menu:

model.name: File Storage - Free Unlimited Use
model.description:
File Storage widget lets you store any file inside it. Anyone can click the widget to download the file.


Features

  1. Upload any file types, store up to 20MB per file.
  2. Set password to lock the file (require password to download).
  3. Show icon (text, image or general), file size and upload date/time.
  4. Options to change widget's theme, size and background.
  5. Only the file owner can delete the file from the widget.


How to Use

  1. Add the File Storage widget and click the widget to open the window.
  2. Drag and Drop any file to the window or click Browse File.
  3. Change the name (optional) or set the password (optional) then click Save.
  4. Click Download to download the file (type password if needed).
  5. Click Delete to delete the file (if you are the owner).


Update

Figma widget cannot update itself, to stay up to date:

  1. Right-mouse click on the widget.
  2. Click Widgets > Update to latest version.


Pricing

  1. Unlimited free use for upload, download and edit file name.
  2. For a one-time purchase, unlock the password feature. Only authorized users can download the file.


Warning

While the widget can store data > 20 MB, storing large files can lead to performance issues (lag) and significant download/upload spikes during interactions. This is because Figma/FigJam is designed to sync data and states across all users whenever the widget is used.

  7. Smart panel size – the panel fits its height to the loaded content and remembers the size you drag it to (resize handle in the corner)

Perfect for

  2. Reviewing interactive HTML prototypes right where the discussion happens
  3. Workshop boards that need working tools, not screenshots
  4. Keeping team utilities on the board instead of scattered links and files
